summary: Excellent PowerShell best practices throughout: Set-StrictMode, -ErrorAction Stop, proper parameter validation, try-catch with meaningful errors, invariant culture for numeric parsing. Workflow uses pinned action refs (v4), least-privilege permissions (contents:read), sensible triggers (push/PR/schedule/dispatch). Code is well-factored with clear normalized shape contract across parsers. Minor opportunities: comment the unicode separator logic in Find-FlakyTest grouping, document -FailOnFailure's dual-mode design (reporter vs validator) more explicitly. Very high-quality, shipping-ready deliverable.
